title: Ajna 🧿
tagline: Spiritual oracle app using World ID to unlock a unique AI-generated message of consciousness.
description:
AJNA is a spiritual web app that unlocks a personal oracle experience through human verification via World ID. Once a user is verified as a real human, they are guided through a short introspective ritual: entering their date of birth, selecting a symbolic card intuitively, and receiving a sacred, AI-generated message tailored to their energetic signature.
The experience is minimalist and immersive, focused on awakening consciousness rather than entertainment. Users can optionally mint their message as a spiritual NFT — a timeless memory anchored in the blockchain.
AJNA bridges decentralized identity and spiritual technology to offer humans not information, but reflection. Let's bring the next web2 million users with apps like this!
how_its_made:
AJNA integrates World ID (via World App) to verify human uniqueness and grant access to the oracle. The frontend was built using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, optimized for a fluid and ritual-like UX.
After human validation, the system calculates the user’s master number from their birthdate using numerology, and then prompts an intuitive card selection. For that the idea was to use pyth for the radonmess generated using that input as a salt. As pyth was not available on wrold chain we tried to implement a crosschain messaging system to get it from optimism using layerZero. 
After the message generation engine uses OpenAI's API to produce spiritually aligned, symbolic messages based on user data and archetypal logic.
We store the timestamped message locally and offer the option to mint it via NFT.storage on IPFS — creating a non-transferable, spiritual memory NFT. There is a payment fee for minting the NFT that shows the power of WorldMiniApp integration.
The design references sacred geometry and chakra symbolism, with subtle animations for depth and immersion.
